## Fixed
- The video player has a pause and resume control and a seek bar, and the stray half-drawn platform control strip is gone, so a video can be stopped or jumped without leaving the page
- A video that runs out now plays the next one from its related list instead of stopping on a still frame, and a queue with nothing behind it leaves the surface's Play ready to start the last video again

## New
- The music tab draws "Artists for you" from the artists you have actually listened to when YouTube Music does not send that shelf
